posts.body: Been a rough couple weeks. Asking for prayers for my son who is in prison.  Was scheduled to be released in April 2027 met with parole and they gave him more time so he can acclimate back into society but then yesterday denied to get to another prison for work release.  I know God has a plan but my mama heart can’t take much more.  The prison system is so broken and so is my heart AGAIN!

🤍 Family & Friends, please keep my family in prayer.  We just lost my cousin unexpectedly from a heart attack at only 47 years old. 💔 Please pray for comfort, strength, and peace for our family during this difficult time.

“The LORD is near to the brokenhearted.” 
— Psalm 34:18 🙏🏽🤍

Asking prayer for a volatile situation at home and in my marriage.
I have nowhere to go but trust that the Lord my GOD will make a way. I have been in survival mode for quite a while but now I feel things are coming to a head. Please offer prayer up for me.

I want to truly release what ive bound in me. Past hurts, uncertainty, fear. I want to release what ive built walls for. I want my faith to be the strongest part of me. I want that faith to lead to obedience. I want to be free from what ive created from shame or hurt. I want to release to Jesus fully and completely the things that have kept me bound. I want freedom from what is not true. I want to embrace and instill that what Jesus did for me the ultimate sacrifice is truly mine. There is nothing left from the past for me to hold on too. I want to know and understand the history and meaning of the Bible the Word. I want the freedom the promises Jesus has been standing over me with for so long. I want his complete love to be in me. I want to go deeper in Jesus to have a trust so great that obedience comes like breathing. Release the shackles so I can have what Jesus is holding in front of me. Peace, joy, love, freedom, abundance..life.

Asking for Jesus to come and guide and protect me. The choices Ive made in feeling I need to fix things are visiting me. Im asking Jesus to take what I realize is a control issue and give me a clean slate and the way to make things right. Ive been forgiven. I am loved. I know he is making a way because he told me. I want all things to be for his glory not mine. In Jesus name I pray. Amen

I would truly appreciate your prayers. I’ve been dealing with migraines on and off for the past week, and I’m asking the Lord for complete healing, strength, and peace. Please pray that He removes this pain, restores my body, and gives me the rest and relief I need.

I stand on God’s promises, believing that He is my Healer and that nothing is impossible for Him.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am healed. Amen. ❤️

Typhoon Bavi is here and destructible. It’s not gonna fit us directly in Guam but we have 95mph wind gust and climbing.  Have had almost four inches of rain in 4 hours.  Hitting our sister island in Rota. Prayers for safety please and thank you!

Please keep my family in your prayers during this difficult time. My uncle recently passed away from a heart attack, and our hearts are heavy with grief.

Please also pray for better health, strength, and God’s protection over my entire family. We are trusting the Lord for comfort, healing, and peace as we navigate this loss.

Thank you for your prayers and support. 🙏🏽❤️
